name: Social Deduction AI
description: Social Deduction AI is a benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to play social deduction games (e.g., Werewolf, Avalon, Among Us-style games), testing strategic reasoning, deception, persuasion, theory of mind, and multi-agent communication in adversarial social settings.
reputation: Emerging benchmark in multi-agent LLM evaluation
notes: Game outcomes are stochastic and depend on agent composition; reproducibility challenges in multi-agent settings; limited details available from website.
